notes.title: Update notes for August 24th
notes.notes:
We have listened and read all your suggestions and have made an update with two aspects of gameplay:

Stealth
We have adjusted the stealth sections so now the enemies return to their original position after Verne is captured.
Final Puzzle
We know that many of you found this puzzle a bit frustrating, so we've increased the timer length to make it more accessible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/e72a529fefa17e2c285d937c4e2c74e7d86c4964.png

Additionally, we have fixed some minor bugs and we have implemented some visual improvements, especially with texts that were not properly aligned.

We hope you enjoy the game!

Vernely yours.
